done_when: On this repo, forge next and the board's JSON output each finish in under five seconds with unchanged output.

known.title: Not done: On this repo, forge next and the board's JSON output each finish in under five seconds with unchanged output.

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. Case: normal use - invoking either command when expired GitHub caches need refreshing. The supplied current-checkout measurements report 7.509 seconds for next and 6.968 seconds for board JSON during cache refresh, exceeding the stated target. Cache refresh is routine operation, and the Done-when has no warm-cache exception. This test primes the caches here and times only the subsequent invocation, so it can pass while that measured failure remains.
